subject: Day 45: Your sound is optimized
preview_text: This is milestone. You're not a new user anymore. Here's what comes next.
body_paragraphs: Day 45. That's not new user territory. You've been here long enough to know what works. The commute, the podcast, the drive—you've dialed it in. But here's the thing: most people stop at 'good enough.' They never discover the feature that turns good into great.

You've already unlocked the basics. The +200% boost. The profiles. But there's a layer most never touch—the one that tunes around your exact headphones, your car, your Bluetooth. The one that makes you forget you're even using an equalizer. It's called Sound DNA. And it's automatic.

Open Loud EQ right now. Tap the Optimize button with your current device plugged in. That one tap analyzes your audio path and sets everything perfectly—from bass to treble. No tweaking needed. Just pure, clear sound at any volume.

This is your next chapter. You're not a new user anymore. You're a power user. And power users don't settle for 'good enough.' They optimize. Tap Optimize now. P.S. The hearing-safe streak is still running. Don't break it.
